entities.summary: William Joseph Green III is an American politician from Pennsylvania. A Democrat, Green served in the U.S. House of Representatives from 1964 to 1977 and as the 94th Mayor of Philadelphia from 1980 to 1984. He is the youngest person ever elected to congress from Pennsylvania, having been elected at the age of 25.
